amendmentOf: the previous real Mac preapproval run that recorded docker.ready = BLOCKED and then continued into the image phase
rule: The earliest mandatory FAIL or BLOCKED is authoritative. Later records can never rehabilitate a run.
enforcement: mac-rail-b-finalise-release.sh refuses any validation summary whose classification is ABORTED_BLOCKED, and refuses any run with blockedCount, failCount or notRunCount above zero.
